name: AI-specific dark patterns and countermeasures
summary: Maps each documented LLM dark pattern to the UI amplifier to prohibit and the system-level countermeasure.
aliases: DarkBench: brand bias, user retention, sycophancy, anthropomorphism, harmful generation, sneaking

anatomy.description: sycophancy → reason-coded feedback, no reward for agreement
retention hooks → task-relevant follow-ups only, no streaks, temporary mode
fake urgency → real progress and quota facts only
anthropomorphism → AI label, no fake typing delays, no human names/avatars by default
hidden data use → memory chip, consent at first run

exemplars: Kran et al. 2025 — some LLMs 'favor their developers' products and exhibit untruthful communication'
Shape of AI — 'Don't fake human interaction'
